name: Cannibal Vampire
summary: A vampire who drinks only vampire blood, and is about a fifth stronger for it.
blood: Vampire blood only. Any other blood has a 20% chance of turning you back into a normal vampire.
strengths: All stats about 20% above an Original Vampire's
weaknesses: Drinking non-vampire blood risks losing the variant (20%)
Sunlight and stakes, as for every vampire
